register.terms.title: ATABEYAPP — TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF USE
register.terms.s1_title: What Atabeyapp is, and what it is not, under any circumstances
register.terms.s1_p1: Atabeyapp is a digital tool. It helps you keep your medical information ready, to use in an emergency.
register.terms.s1_p2: Atabeyapp is not a medical device. It doesn't hold any official certification as a healthcare product. This means it has no official clinical validity by itself.
register.terms.s1_p3: Atabeyapp does not replace a doctor's diagnosis. Nor does it replace any treatment, or any medical prescription. A health professional's judgment always takes priority over the information in this app.
register.terms.s1_p4: Using Atabeyapp does not create any doctor-patient relationship. Atabeyapp is, solely, a support tool. It is not, in itself, a medical service.
register.terms.s2_title: Your responsibility for the data you enter
register.terms.s2_p1: You are the sole person responsible for your medical data in Atabeyapp. This includes it being true. It also includes it being complete, and up to date.
register.terms.s2_p2_html:
You commit to doing the following:
— Entering only true information, matching what your doctor has told you.
— Updating your data whenever something changes. This includes your medical situation, your medication, or your allergies.
— Keeping your QR code accessible, at all times. This matters, for emergencies.
— Telling your family, and your emergency contacts. They should know the QR code exists. They should also know where to find it.
register.terms.s2_p3: Atabeyapp warns you about something important. Incorrect, outdated, or false medical data can be more dangerous than no data at all. It can lead a doctor to make the wrong decision. This can have serious consequences. In some cases, it can put your life at risk.
register.terms.s2_p4: For this reason, Atabeyapp is not responsible for problems caused by incorrect, false, or outdated data that you entered.
register.terms.s3_p1: During registration, you enter some identity data. These are your full name, your surname, your date of birth, your identity document number, and your email address.
register.terms.s3_p2: This data is locked, forever. This happens right after you verify your account, with the code we send to your email. Once locked, it cannot be changed.
register.terms.s3_p3: This measure exists for security reasons. Its purpose is to protect your identity. It also prevents someone else from impersonating you.
register.terms.s3_p4: If you made a mistake writing your identity data, there's a solution. You must cancel your account. Afterwards, you can create a new account, with the correct data. Atabeyapp cannot modify already-verified identity data, under any circumstances.
register.terms.s4_title: Your account's security, with six layers of protection
register.terms.s4_p1: Atabeyapp uses six security layers to protect your account and your data.
register.terms.s4_p2: The first layer verifies your email address, during registration, with a one-time code.
register.terms.s4_p3: The second layer is your personal password. You choose it. It's never stored as plain text, always encrypted, with security methods recognized as an industry standard.
register.terms.s4_p4: The third layer is two-factor authentication, also called 2FA, pronounced letter by letter: 2, F, A. This is mandatory. You can choose one of these three methods: your fingerprint or your face, if your device supports it; the Google Authenticator app; or a code we send to your email.
register.terms.s4_p5: The fourth layer encrypts your medical data, with a key that comes from your own account. No one can read it without your QR code.
register.terms.s4_p6: The fifth layer is exclusive access, through your personal QR code. There is no other way to access your medical information.
register.terms.s4_p7: The sixth layer is the audit log. Every access made through your QR is recorded, with date, time, and internet address.
register.terms.s4_p8: You are responsible for three things: keeping your password safe, without sharing it with anyone; keeping your two-factor method active; and notifying Atabeyapp immediately, if you suspect someone accessed your account without permission.
register.terms.s5_p1: If you lose access to your account, you can start recovering it from the sign-in screen.
register.terms.s5_p2: To recover your account, you need four things: access to your registered email address; verifying a code we send to that email, valid for 30 minutes; confirming your identity with your two-factor method; and creating a new password.
register.terms.s5_p3: If you type the verification code wrong, the system warns you. It tells you how many attempts you have left. After three failed attempts in a row, your account goes into a temporary lockout, immediately.
register.terms.s5_p4: At that point, you have two options.
register.terms.s5_p5: The first option is recovering the account. We send a recovery code to your email address. You have 30 minutes to complete the verification. You need that code, your two-factor method, and a new password. If you don't finish this process within 30 minutes, your account is cancelled automatically. This cancellation cannot be undone. This means you'll lose all your saved medical data. And that you'd have to register again from scratch, as if you were a new user.
register.terms.s5_p6: The second option is cancelling the account. This deletes all your data, immediately, and forever. Afterwards, you can create a new account, from the start.
register.terms.s5_p7: Atabeyapp cannot give you access to an account without you completing the entire verification process. This is the case under any circumstances. Its purpose is to protect your medical data.
register.terms.s6_title: Cancelling your account, permanently and irreversibly
register.terms.s6_p1: You can cancel your account at any time. This is done from your profile settings. This action cannot be undone.
register.terms.s6_p2: Cancelling your account does three things: it deletes, forever, all your data stored on our servers; it invalidates, immediately, all the QR codes you generated with that account; and it makes it impossible to recover your data, once the cancellation is complete.
register.terms.s6_p3: To cancel your account, you need to confirm three things: your password; your two-factor method; and typing the word ELIMINAR, in the confirmation field.
register.terms.s7_title: How we store your information, with no surprises
register.terms.s7_p1: Your identity data is stored on our servers, to manage your account securely.
register.terms.s7_p2: Your medical data is stored encrypted, with systems recognized as an industry standard. We do this for a single reason: making emergency access possible, from any device. This is Atabeyapp's essential purpose. That a healthcare professional can access your information, right when you need it most.
register.terms.s7_p3: No one can read your medical data. This includes the Atabeyapp team. Your data is encrypted, with a key that comes from your own account. It can only be read when someone scans your personal QR code.
register.terms.s7_p4: Every time someone accesses your data with your QR, we log it. We store the date, the time, and the internet address of that access.
register.terms.s7_p5: If you cancel your account, we also delete this access log, along with the rest of your data. We keep no history after cancellation.
register.terms.s8_title: The use of your QR code, in a real medical emergency
register.terms.s8_p1: Your Atabeyapp QR code has a clear purpose. It's designed for healthcare staff to use, in a medical emergency.
register.terms.s8_p2: You expressly authorize healthcare staff to access your medical information, through your QR code, in an emergency situation.
register.terms.s8_p3: The information in your QR is for guidance only. It is not a binding source for healthcare staff. The doctor, or paramedic, must always check this information against your official medical history, before making a critical medical decision.
register.terms.s8_p4: Atabeyapp cannot control how healthcare staff use the information in your QR code. For this reason, we are not responsible for that use.
register.terms.s9_p1: To use Atabeyapp, you need to be at least 21 years old. Atabeyapp sets this age because it seeks a sufficient level of maturity to be responsible for medical data.
register.terms.s9_p2: If you are 21 or older, but you cannot enter your own data yourself —for example, due to a disability, or a situation of dependency—, your legal guardian can do it on your behalf.
register.terms.s9_p3: Atabeyapp does not verify documentation for legal guardian status. Whoever declares acting as a guardian, by checking the corresponding confirmation box, takes on full legal responsibility for that declaration towards Atabeyapp. If that declaration were false, responsibility for any resulting consequence lies exclusively with whoever made it. Atabeyapp reserves the right to cancel any account where there are reasonable grounds to suspect a false guardianship declaration.
register.terms.s10_title: Changes to these terms, always with prior notice
register.terms.s10_p1: Atabeyapp may change these terms at any time. If we make an important change, we'll notify you by email. We'll notify you at least 15 days before the change takes effect.
register.terms.s10_p2: If you keep using Atabeyapp after that notice, this means you accept the new terms. If you don't accept them, you must cancel your account, before the date the change takes effect.
register.terms.s11_title: Limits of our liability, explained clearly
register.terms.s11_p1: Atabeyapp, the people who created it, and those who contribute to the project, are not liable for certain damages. This includes direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use, or misuse, of the app.
register.terms.s11_p2: Some examples of this are: medical decisions based on incorrect information that you entered; loss of access to your account due to losing your credentials; unauthorized use of the QR codes you generated; and service interruption due to technical causes, or force majeure.
register.terms.s11_p3: No digital system offers absolute security. Atabeyapp does not assume liability for incidents beyond its control, or beyond its reasonable diligence.
register.terms.s12_title: Applicable law, and where disputes are resolved
register.terms.s12_p1: These terms are governed by applicable Spanish law. If any dispute arises regarding the use of Atabeyapp, both parties submit to the Courts and Tribunals of Madrid. This means we expressly waive any other venue where that dispute could be resolved.
register.terms.s12_p2: Three main laws apply to Atabeyapp. The European Union's General Data Protection Regulation, known as GDPR. Spanish Organic Law 3, of 2018, on the Protection of Personal Data and the Guarantee of Digital Rights, known as LOPDGDD. And Spanish Law 34, of 2002, on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce, known as LSSI.

index.delete_account.intro: By confirming, your account and all your data will be permanently and immediately deleted. This includes:
index.delete_account.item_profile: Your full medical profile (allergies, history, emergency contacts, everything you filled in).
index.delete_account.item_qr: The 9 generated QR codes — they'll stop working immediately. Any printed QR, on your bracelet, or saved on your phone will no longer show any information.
index.delete_account.subscription_note: If you have an active paid subscription (Pro), it will be cancelled automatically when you delete your account. No further charges will be made, but the period already paid will not be refunded.
index.delete_account.no_recovery_note: There is no way to recover this data after confirming. There is no backup or grace period — deletion is immediate and final.
index.delete_account.gdpr_note: This request is processed in accordance with your right to erasure ("right to be forgotten") under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the LOPDGDD.
index.delete_account.confirm_instruction: To confirm, enter your password and type ELIMINAR in the field below.

index.tutor_modal.title: Legal guardian declaration
index.tutor_modal.body_html:
By continuing, you declare under your responsibility that:

1. The contact details entered belong to a person who holds legal guardian status through a valid enabling document (court ruling, notarial document, or equivalent administrative record).

2. This declaration does NOT grant or prove legal guardian status — it is purely informational. ATABEYAPP does not verify the truthfulness of this information nor the existence of the corresponding legal document.

3. Entering data for a person who does not legally hold that status, or falsely presenting yourself as a legal guardian, may constitute usurpation of civil status (art. 401 CP), document forgery (arts. 390-392 CP) and/or fraud (art. 248 CP).

4. Responsibility for any inaccuracy lies exclusively with whoever enters this data.
